overview.name: m+ Nasdaq-100 Accelerator Autocall ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in unfunded total return swaps (based on their notional value) that provide exposure to the Barclays Nasdaq-100 Accelerator Autocallable Index (the “Autocall Index”). It is non-diversified.
